title: THC Advanced Environment and Lighting Certificate
publicDescription: Demonstrates applied capability in environmental data quality, VPD context, PPFD and DLI interpretation, spatial uniformity, equipment verification, and escalation of control-system deviations.
limitations: This Academy credential is educational and employment-oriented; it is not a government cannabis license or occupational license.
It does not authorize electrical, HVAC, refrigerant, or building-control work beyond workplace authorization and qualified-trade requirements.
